scope: Native Context-owned language prerequisites; CPU host SDK C/CPP only, not complete xlang or graphical/static delivery.
testCorrection: The frozen SDK carries the first test-only XUI_TR_OK spelling. The executed test source uses authoritative XUI_TR_EDIT_COPY and is hashed separately in sources/native reports; engine code and SDK bytes are unchanged.

contracts.lifetime: Context registry owner; observer invalidation precedes string/slot/storage release.
contracts.rollback: Unpublished custom pack only; bool removed is independent from tail status. Active, built-in or fallback-referenced packs reject without removal.
contracts.ids: Reject INT_MAX/exhausted allocator before increment; no rewind of IDs/revisions/capacity after failed publication.
contracts.texts: Read-only own slots preserve unset/empty; Translate retains existing fallback semantics; mutable raw xarray remains explicit C interoperability.

costs: One pointer per native pack; no observer/query allocation; creation scope/watch plus existing copies/storage. Language snapshots, common lifecycle checks and actual backend costs are separate.
remaining: Downstream xlang declarations and general const-char NULL-alias physical ABI normalization, full compiler/static language/actual graphical acceptance and final SDK/IDE delivery remain in active goal.
